name: Cek Diabetes
description:
Cek Diabetes adalah pemeriksaan medis untuk mengukur kadar gula darah guna deteksi dini dan pemantauan diabetes. Tes diabetes dilakukan melalui pemeriksaan gula darah puasa dan HbA1c, yang memberi gambaran rata-rata kadar gula darah 3 bulan terakhir.


✅Tindakan dilakukan di rumah (home service) / dari mana saja dengan layanan Homecare by Halodoc tanpa biaya tambahan

✅Dilakukan 100% oleh Tenaga Medis Bersertifikat

✅Sampel darah/urine dibawa langsung ke lab, dijamin aman & steril

✅Bonus Kupon Chat Dokter setelah Tindakan


Manfaat Cek Diabetes

  • Deteksi dini diabetes: Mengetahui apakah kadar gula darah normal atau meningkat, sebagai gambaran risiko pre-diabetes atau diabetes.
  • Pemantauan pengobatan: Bagi penderita diabetes untuk mengontrol kadar gula darah secara berkala.
  • Pencegahan komplikasi: Mengurangi risiko komplikasi seperti penyakit jantung, gangguan ginjal, dan kerusakan saraf.
  • Meningkatkan kesadaran kesehatan: Membantu penerapan pola hidup sehat secara disiplin.


Siapa yang Membutuhkan Cek Diabetes?

  • Orang dengan riwayat keluarga diabetes
  • Orang dengan obesitas atau gaya hidup kurang aktif
  • Orang yang mengalami pre-diabetes
  • Penderita tekanan darah tinggi atau kolesterol tinggi
  • Wanita yang pernah mengalami diabetes gestasional
  • Siapa saja yang ingin memastikan kadar gula darahnya tetap normal


Kapan Sebaiknya Melakukan Cek Diabetes?

  • Jika mengalami gejala seperti sering haus, sering buang air kecil, cepat lelah, atau berat badan menurun tanpa sebab
  • Minimal sekali dalam setahun bagi yang berisiko tinggi
  • Rutin sesuai anjuran dokter bagi penderita diabetes atau prediabetes



Penting : Hasil tesmu mungkin tersedia dalam waktu 1 - 2 hari jika sampelmu diambil sekitar Hari Libur Nasional atau akhir pekan. Silakan cek hasil tesmu secara berkala di halaman ‘Riwayat Transaksi’.

﻿Tindakan ini tidak ditujukan untuk pasien di bawah 5 tahun kecuali dengan rujukan dokter.

name: Diabetes Test
description:
A Diabetes Check is a medical exam to measure blood sugar levels for early detection and monitoring of diabetes. This diabetes test is conducted through a fasting blood sugar test and an HbA1c test, which provides an overview of average blood sugar levels over the past 3 months.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅Performed 100% by Certified Medical Personnel

✅Blood/urine samples are taken directly to the lab, guaranteed safe & sterile

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


Benefits of Diabetes Check

  • Early detection of diabetes: Helps identify normal or elevated blood sugar levels, indicating pre-diabetes or diabetes risk.
  • Treatment monitoring: Supports diabetes patients in tracking their sugar levels.
  • Prevention of complications: Monitoring can reduce the risk of issues like heart disease, kidney damage, and nerve problems.
  • Increased health awareness: Encourages a healthier and more disciplined lifestyle.


Who Needs a Diabetes Check?

  • People with a family history of diabetes
  • Those with obesity or inactive lifestyles
  • Individuals diagnosed with pre-diabetes
  • People with high blood pressure or cholesterol
  • Women with a history of gestational diabetes
  • Anyone wanting to maintain normal blood sugar levels


When is it Best to Get a Diabetes Check?

  • If showing symptoms like frequent thirst, urination, fatigue, or sudden weight loss
  • Annually for high-risk individuals
  • Routinely, as recommended by a doctor, for those with diabetes or pre-diabetes


Important : Your test results may be available within 1 - 2 days if your sample is collected just before a public holiday or the weekend. Check your results periodically on the ‘History’ page.

﻿This procedure is not intended for patients under 5 years old unless referred by a doctor.
preparation:

name: Cek Fungsi Hati
description:
Cek Fungsi Hati adalah pemeriksaan medis yang bertujuan untuk mengevaluasi kinerja hati dalam menjalankan fungsinya, seperti menyaring racun, memproduksi protein, dan membantu proses pencernaan.

Gaya hidup tidak sehat, seperti pola makan tinggi lemak dan gula, kurang aktivitas fisik, atau konsumsi alkohol berlebihan, dapat menyebabkan perlemakan hati (fatty liver) yang berisiko mengganggu fungsi hati. Pemeriksaan fungsi hati ini biasanya meliputi tes enzim hati (SGPT, SGOT), kadar bilirubin, dan protein darah untuk mengetahui adanya gangguan fungsi hati.


✅Tindakan dilakukan di rumah (home service) / dari mana saja dengan layanan Homecare by Halodoc tanpa biaya tambahan

✅Dilakukan 100% oleh Tenaga Medis Bersertifikat

✅Sampel darah/urine dibawa langsung ke lab, dijamin aman & steril

✅Bonus Kupon Chat Dokter setelah Tindakan


Manfaat Cek Fungsi Hati

  • Mendeteksi gangguan hati sejak dini, seperti hepatitis, sirosis, atau perlemakan hati.
  • Membantu memantau efektivitas pengobatan penyakit hati.
  • Menilai dampak konsumsi obat-obatan atau alkohol terhadap kesehatan hati.
  • Mendukung upaya pencegahan komplikasi akibat gangguan hati.


Siapa yang Membutuhkan Cek Fungsi Hati?

  • Orang dengan riwayat penyakit hati atau keluarga dengan gangguan hati.
  • Penderita diabetes, obesitas, atau hipertensi yang berisiko mengalami gangguan hati.
  • Individu yang sering mengonsumsi alkohol atau obat-obatan tertentu dalam jangka panjang.
  • Pasien yang sedang menjalani terapi obat yang dapat memengaruhi fungsi hati.


Kapan Sebaiknya Melakukan Cek Fungsi Hati?

  • Saat mengalami gejala seperti kelelahan berlebihan, kulit dan mata menguning, urine gelap, atau nyeri di area hati.
  • Sebagai bagian dari pemeriksaan kesehatan rutin, terutama bagi individu dengan risiko tinggi.
  • Sebelum memulai atau selama menjalani pengobatan tertentu yang dapat memengaruhi hati.
  • Jika memiliki kebiasaan hidup yang dapat berisiko terhadap kesehatan hati, seperti konsumsi alkohol berlebihan.


Tindakan ini tidak ditujukan untuk pasien di bawah 5 tahun kecuali dengan rujukan dokter.

  • Informasikan kepada petugas jika ada obat/suplemen yang rutin dikonsumsi.
  • Mengenakan pakaian yang mudah dilipat pada bagian lengan.

  • Membantu mendeteksi kadar kolesterol tinggi yang dapat meningkatkan risiko penyakit jantung dan stroke.
  • Memantau efektivitas perubahan gaya hidup atau pengobatan untuk mengontrol kolesterol.

  • Mendorong pola hidup sehat dengan pemantauan rutin kadar kolesterol.


Siapa yang Membutuhkan Cek Kolesterol?

Pemeriksaan cek kolesterol ini disarankan untuk:

  • Orang dewasa berusia di atas 20 tahun, terutama jika memiliki riwayat keluarga dengan kadar kolesterol tinggi atau penyakit jantung.
  • Penderita diabetes, tekanan darah tinggi, atau obesitas.

  • Orang yang sedang menjalani pengobatan penurun kolesterol untuk memantau efektivitas terapi

  • Lebih sering (setiap 1-2 tahun) bagi mereka yang memiliki faktor risiko seperti tekanan darah tinggi, obesitas, atau riwayat keluarga dengan penyakit jantung.

name: Cholesterol Test
description:
Cholesterol Check is a medical examination performed to measure cholesterol levels in the blood, including total cholesterol, LDL (bad cholesterol), HDL (good cholesterol), and triglycerides. This examination is important for assessing the risk of heart disease, cardiovascular, and other health problems related to blood fat levels.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅Performed 100% by Certified Medical Personnel

✅Blood/urine samples are taken directly to the lab, guaranteed safe & sterile

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


Benefits of Cholesterol Check

  • Helps detect high cholesterol levels that can increase the risk of heart disease and stroke.
  • Monitors the effectiveness of lifestyle changes or medication to control cholesterol.
  • Prevents health complications due to plaque buildup in blood vessels.
  • Encourages a healthy lifestyle with routine monitoring of cholesterol levels.


Who Needs a Cholesterol Check?

This cholesterol check examination is recommended for:

  • Adults over 20 years old, especially if they have a family history of high cholesterol or heart disease.
  • People with diabetes, high blood pressure, or obesity.
  • Individuals with a diet high in saturated fat or a less active lifestyle.
  • People undergoing cholesterol-lowering medication to monitor the effectiveness of therapy.


When Should a Cholesterol Check Be Done?

  • At least every 4-6 years for healthy adults.
  • More often (every 1-2 years) for those with risk factors such as high blood pressure, obesity, or a family history of heart disease.
  • As recommended by a doctor for people with diabetes or those taking cholesterol-lowering medication.


This procedure is not intended for patients under 5 years old unless referred by a doctor.

  • Detects anemia early before causing serious complications.

  • Helps understand the causes of fatigue, dizziness, or weakness that may be related to anemia.
  • Assists doctors in determining appropriate treatment or supplements.


Who Needs an Anemia and Iron Check?

  • People who often feel weak, dizzy, or experience shortness of breath.

name: Urinary Tract Infection Test
description:
A Blood and Urine Infection Check is a medical test using blood and urine samples to detect infections or inflammation in the body, including urinary tract infections (UTIs).

Infections often cause an increase (or sometimes a decrease) in white blood cell (leukocyte) count and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), whether from viral or bacterial causes. UTIs can be identified through abnormalities in urine test results.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅Performed 100% by Certified Medical Personnel

✅Blood/urine samples are taken directly to the lab, guaranteed safe & sterile

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


Benefits of Checking for Urinary Tract Infections

  • Early Detection of Infection: Confirms infection presence early, allowing prompt treatment before it spreads to kidneys.
  • Determining the Right Treatment: Helps doctors select the correct antibiotic.
  • Preventing Complications: Reduces risk of serious infections like kidney infections or sepsis.
  • Monitoring Urinary Tract Health: Useful for those with frequent UTIs or higher risk of infections.


Who Needs a Urinary Tract Infection Check?

  • Individuals showing UTI symptoms such as painful urination, cloudy or strong-smelling urine.
  • Pregnant women, who are more prone to UTIs.
  • People with diabetes or weakened immune systems.
  • Patients with recurring urinary tract infections.


When Should You Get a Urinary Tract Infection Check?

  • If experiencing frequent urination, pain, or cloudy urine.
  • While undergoing UTI treatment to assess therapy effectiveness.
  • As a routine check-up for those at higher risk.


This procedure is not intended for patients under 5 years old unless referred by a doctor.

Urine tests are not available for patients who use a catheter.

  • Helps assess fluid and electrolyte balance to prevent dehydration or overhydration
  • Detects kidney problems that affect electrolyte levels

  • Mendeteksi penyebab alergi secara akurat untuk memudahkan penanganan dan pencegahan.
  • Membantu mengurangi gejala alergi seperti gatal, sesak napas, gangguan pencernaan, dengan menghindari pemicu.

Cek darah untuk alergi disarankan untuk:

Benefits of Blood Test for Allergies

  • Accurately detects the cause of allergies, making treatment and prevention easier.
  • Helps reduce allergy symptoms, such as itching, shortness of breath, or digestive disorders, by avoiding allergy triggers.
  • Prevents more severe allergic reactions, including high-risk anaphylaxis.
  • Aids in planning a healthy diet and lifestyle, especially for those with food or environmental allergies.


Who Needs a Blood Test for Allergies?

A blood test for allergies is recommended for:

  • Rhinitis (sneezing, runny or blocked nose)
  • Conjunctivitis (itchy, watery eyes)
  • Asthma symptoms (cough, wheezing, breathlessness)
  • Skin issues (hives, eczema)
  • Digestive problems (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea)
  • Also recommended for those with a family history of allergies to understand personal risk.


When is the Best Time to Get a Blood Test for Allergies?

  • When allergic symptoms appear but the trigger is unknown
  • Before avoiding certain foods or changing your diet
  • After severe allergic reactions to find exact triggers
  • As a routine check for those with allergy or autoimmune history

Pemeriksaan kesehatan yang lengkap untuk memeriksa kesehatanmu secara menyeluruh. Meliputi tes lab menggunakan sampel darah dan urine serta pemeriksaan fisik yang dilaksanakan oleh dokter.


Paket ini direkomendasikan untuk memeriksa kondisi kesehatan karyawan.


This package only applies to Onsite MCU PT Pool Advista Finance.


Tentang Layanan Halodoc Home Lab:

  • Tes/paket ini tidak tersedia untuk pasien di bawah usia 5 tahun.
  • Harga sudah termasuk pemeriksaan lab dan konsultasi dokter online hingga senilai Rp25.000. Konsultasi dapat ditebus setelah hasil tersedia.
  • Harga sudah termasuk biaya layanan, transportasi, dan APD.
  • Pengambilan sampel akan berlangsung selama 10-15 menit setelah staf medis tiba.
  • Pengambilan sampel dianjurkan dilakukan di rumah atau tempat lain yang steril dan mudah diakses staf medis. Sampel akan diperiksa di laboratorium rekanan Halodoc.


Kebijakan Pembatalan & Pengembalian Dana:

  • Pembatalan pesanan dan pengembalian dana tidak dapat dilakukan jika staf medis sudah menuju lokasimu.
  • Pembatalan pesanan dapat dilakukan melalui aplikasi paling lambat 24 jam dari jadwal yang dipilih, atau melalui admin WhatsApp paling lambat 3 jam sebelum jadwal.
  • Jadwal pengambilan sampel dapat diubah paling lambat 3 jam sebelum jadwal yang telah ditentukan.
preparation:
• Puasa tidak makan selama 9 - 12 jam sebelum tindakan, hanya boleh minum air putih, masih diperbolehkan mengkonsumsi obat rutin.
  • Informasikan kepada petugas jika ada obat/suplemen yang rutin dikonsumsi.
  • Mengenakan pakaian yang mudah dilipat pada bagian lengan.
  • Bagi pasien perempuan, pastikan sudah selesai masa menstruasi agar hasil tidak terkontaminasi.
  • Tidak buang air kecil 30 menit - 1 jam sebelum pemeriksaan, pengambilan urine akan dilakukan saat petugas datang.


Informasi Penting:

  • Untuk memastikan kesesuaian data medis, pastikan profil yang dipilih adalah profil pasien yang akan melakukan tes/injeksi. Kamu dapat pilih atau buat profil pada bagian atas halaman ‘Keranjang’ Home Lab.
  • Admin Home Lab akan menghubungimu via WhatsApp untuk mengkonfirmasi jadwal dan alamat pengambilan sampel. Jadwal dapat berubah menyesuaikan ketersediaan staf medis, cuaca, atau kendala lainnya. Pastikan nomormu dapat dihubungi.
  • Jika kamu memiliki kendala atau pertanyaan lebih lanjut, hubungi Customer Support kami melalui chat, email help@halodoc.com, dan/atau telepon di nomor 02150959900.
test_sample:
• Darah yang diambil dari pembuluh darah vena pada lengan.
  • Urine (minimal 30 mL). Sebaiknya dilakukan dengan urine porsi tengah.

*Staf medis akan menunggu maks.30 menit.

name: MCU - PT Pool Advista Finance - Executive Package
description:
A complete, in-depth health screening to assess your overall fitness. Includes lab tests using blood and urine samples and a physical examination conducted by a doctor.


This package is recommended as to check overall employee health.


Paket ini hanya berlaku untuk Onsite MCU PT Pool Advista Finance.


About Halodoc Home Lab Services:

  • This test/package isn’t available for patients under 5 years old.
  • Price includes a lab examination and an online doctor consultation up to Rp25.000. You can redeem your consultation once your results are published.
  • Prices include service fees, transportation fees, and PPE costs.
  • Sampling will take 10-15 minutes once the medical staff arrives at your location.
  • Sampling is recommended to be done at home or in a sterile and easily accessible place. The sample will be examined at laboratory partner from Halodoc.


Terms for Cancellation & Refund:

  • Cancelations and refunds cannot be made if the medical staff is already on the way to your location.
  • Cancelation can be done via the app within 24 hours after your chosen schedule or via WhatsApp Admin 3 hours beforehand.
  • The reschedule can be done at least 3 hours prior to the original schedule.
preparation:
• Fast 9 - 12 hours before sample collection. You are not allowed to eat, but you are still allowed to drink water and consume routine drugs. 
  • If you are consuming routine medications or supplements, please inform our medical staff.
  • Wear loose clothing that allows for easy blood withdrawal from your mid-arm or upper-arm area.
  • For female patients, please ensure that your menstruation period is done during sample collection to avoid urine contamination.
  • Do not urinate 30 mins - 1 hour before sample collection.


Important Information:

  • To ensure the accuracy of the patient’s medical records, make sure the profile you selected belongs to the patient getting the test/injection. You can select or create a profile at the top section of your Home Lab ‘Cart’ page.
  • Halodoc Home Lab Service Admin will contact you via WhatsApp to confirm the schedule and address. The schedule may change depending on the availability of medical staff, weather-related constraints, or force majeure. Make sure your number is reachable.
  • If you have further problems or questions, you can contact our Customer Support via chat, email at help@halodoc.com, or call Customer Support phone number at 02150959900.

name: Vaksinasi HPV Kuadrivalen (Gardasil)
description:
Vaksinasi HPV Kuadrivalen (Gardasil) adalah vaksin yang memberikan perlindungan aktif terhadap 4 jenis virus papillomavirus manusia (HPV): tipe 6, 11, 16, dan 18, yang dapat menyebabkan kutil kelamin dan berbagai jenis kanker seperti kanker serviks, vulva, vagina, penis, dan lainnya. Direkomendasikan untuk perempuan berusia 9 - 45 tahun dan laki-laki berusia 9 - 26 tahun.

Untuk individu di atas 13 tahun, vaksin diberikan dalam 3 dosis dengan interval 0, 2, dan 6 bulan dari dosis pertama (dosis kedua diberikan 2 bulan setelah dosis pertama dan dosis ketiga diberikan 6 bulan setelah dosis pertama). Untuk individu berusia 9 - 13 tahun, vaksin diberikan dalam 2 dosis (dosis kedua diberikan 6 bulan setelah dosis pertama). 1 pesanan ini hanya meliputi 1 dosis vaksin, silakan lakukan pemesanan ulang untuk dosis kedua dan ketiga.

name: HPV Quadrivalent Vaccination (Gardasil)
description:
Quadrivalent HPV Vaccine (Gardasil) a vaccine designed to protect against Human Papillomavirus (HPV) types 6, 11, 16, and 18. HPV is a common virus that can lead to genital warts and several cancers including cervical, vulvar, vaginal, anal, and oropharyngeal cancer.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅100% performed by Vaccination Specialist Doctors

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure

1 booking only includes 1 dose. You are required to create a new booking for your next dose. 


Benefits of Quadrivalent HPV Vaccination (Gardasil)

  • Helps prevent cervical cancer mainly caused by HPV types 16 and 18.
  • Protects against vulvar, vaginal, and anal cancers linked to HPV.
  • Quadrivalent HPV Vaccine (Gardasil) is effective in preventing genital warts caused by HPV types 6 and 11.
  • May reduce the risk of oropharyngeal cancer associated with HPV.


Contents of the Quadrivalent HPV Vaccine (Gardasil)

Each dose contains:

  • Recombinant L1 proteins from HPV types 6, 11, 16, and 18.
  • Adjuvant: Amorphous Aluminum Hydroxyphosphate Sulfate (AAHS).
  • Other ingredients: sodium chloride, L-histidine, polysorbate 80, sodium borate, yeast protein, and water for injection.
  • Free from preservatives or antibiotics.


Who Should Get the Quadrivalent HPV Vaccine (Gardasil)

  • Females aged 9–45 years.
  • Males aged 9–26 years.
  • Ideally given before becoming sexually active for maximum protection.


HPV Vaccination Schedule (Gardasil)

As per IDAI and PAPDI:

  • Ages 9–14: 2 doses (6–12 months apart).
  • Ages 15–45 (females) / 15–26 (males): 3 doses at months 0, 2, and 6.


Contraindications

  • History of severe allergic reaction to any vaccine component, including yeast, or a prior dose of Gardasil.
  • Not recommended during pregnancy—consult your doctor.
  • Delay vaccination during moderate or severe illness (e.g., high fever).

  • Protection Against Pneumonia - Prevents lung infections that can cause serious complications.

  • Reduces the Risk of Serious Complications - Especially for infants, the elderly, and individuals with weakened immune systems.

  • Polysaccharides from Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6A, 6B, 7F, 9V, 14, 18C, 19A, 19F, and 23F.

Vaksin ini mengandung polisakarida kapsular Vi yang membantu merangsang sistem kekebalan tubuh untuk membentuk perlindungan terhadap bakteri penyebab tifoid.

Manfaat Vaksinasi Tifoid (Typhim Vi)

Vaksin tifoid memiliki berbagai manfaat, baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung:

  • Perlindungan terhadap demam tifoid - Mengurangi risiko infeksi Salmonella typhi, yang dapat menyebabkan demam tinggi, gangguan pencernaan, dan komplikasi serius.
  • Mengurangi penyebaran tifoid – Membantu mencegah penyebaran bakteri kepada orang lain, terutama di lingkungan dengan sanitasi kurang baik.
  • Perlindungan jangka panjang – Memberikan perlindungan hingga 3 tahun setelah vaksinasi.


Kandungan Vaksin Typhim Vi

  • Polisakarida Vi murni dari S. typhi strain Ty2.
  • Fenol (sebagai pengawet), Natrium Klorida, Disodium Fosfat, Monosodium Fosfat, Air steril untuk injeksi.

  • Anak-anak di atas 2 tahun dan orang dewasa yang tinggal di daerah dengan risiko tinggi tifoid.

  • Pekerja di bidang kesehatan atau lingkungan dengan sanitasi yang buruk.

name: Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi)
description:
Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi) is a vaccine used to prevent infection by the bacteria Salmonella typhi, the main cause of typhoid fever or typhoid fever. This vaccine contains Vi capsular polysaccharide which helps stimulate the body's immune system to form protection against the bacteria that cause typhoid.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

Benefits of Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi)

Typhoid vaccine has various benefits, both directly and indirectly:

  • Protection against typhoid fever - Reduces the risk of Salmonella typhi infection, which can cause high fever, digestive problems, and serious complications.
  • Reduces the spread of typhoid – Helps prevent the spread of bacteria to others, especially in environments with poor sanitation.
  • Long-term protection – Provides protection for up to 3 years after vaccination.


Contents of Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi)

  • Purified Vi polysaccharide from S. typhi Ty2 strain.
  • Phenol (as preservative), Sodium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate, Monosodium Phosphate, Sterile Water for Injection.


Who Should Get the Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi)

  • Children over 2 years old and adults living in areas with a high risk of typhoid.
  • Travelers who will be traveling to areas with high typhoid cases.
  • Workers in health or environmental fields with poor sanitation.


Typhoid Vaccination (Typhim Vi) Schedule

  • Administered as a single 0.5 mL dose.
  • Revaccination is recommended every 3 years.


Contraindications

This vaccine is not recommended for:

  • Individuals with a history of severe allergies to vaccine components.
  • Children under 2 years of age.
  • Individuals with certain medical conditions that affect the immune system, unless advised by a doctor.

Contents of Meningitis Vaccine (Menivax ACYW)

This meningitis vaccine contains:

  • Polysaccharides from serogroups A, C, Y, W-135 (to trigger immune response)
  • Lactose (stabilizer)
  • Water for injection (solvent)

name: Dengue Fever Test
description:
A Blood Test for Dengue Fever is a medical examination aimed at detecting the presence of the dengue virus in the body. This test includes examining platelet count, hematocrit, liver function, and specific tests such as the NS1 antigen or IgM/IgG dengue to confirm the diagnosis.

Dengue Fever (DHF) is caused by the dengue virus through the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. It can cause high fever, muscle and joint pain, skin rash, and a decrease in platelet count, which can lead to serious complications if not treated quickly.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅Performed 100% by Certified Medical Personnel

✅Blood/urine samples are taken directly to the lab, guaranteed safe & sterile

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


Benefits of a Blood Test for Dengue Fever

  • Early Detection: Helps identify dengue infection early for faster treatment when symptoms like fever or red spots appear.
  • Confirms Diagnosis: Differentiates dengue fever from other diseases with similar symptoms, such as typhoid or malaria.
  • Prevents Worsening: With accurate results, doctors can determine the appropriate treatment and prevent complications like bleeding or dengue shock syndrome.


Who Needs a Blood Test for Dengue Fever?

  • People with a high fever for 2–5 days without a clear cause.
  • People with fever and symptoms such as muscle pain, headache, nausea, or red rash.
  • People living in areas prone to dengue fever, especially during rainy or transitional seasons.


When is it Best to Get a Blood Test for Dengue Fever?

  • If experiencing a high fever for more than 2 days without a clear cause.
  • When symptoms such as muscle pain, headache, nausea, or red spots appear.


This procedure is not intended for patients under 5 years old unless referred by a doctor.

name: Vaksinasi HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9)
description:
Vaksin HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9) adalah vaksin yang digunakan untuk melindungi dari infeksi Human Papillomavirus (virus HPV) yang mencakup sembilan tipe HPV berisiko tinggi.

Memberikan perlindungan yang lebih luas dibandingkan dengan vaksin HPV sebelumnya, lebih efektif dalam mencegah kanker dan penyakit yang disebabkan oleh HPV.


✅Tindakan dilakukan di rumah (home service) / dari mana saja dengan layanan Homecare by Halodoc tanpa biaya tambahan

✅Dilakukan 100% oleh Dokter Khusus Vaksinasi

✅Bonus Kupon Chat Dokter setelah Tindakan

1 pesanan hanya meliputi 1 dosis. Kamu perlu membuat pesanan baru untuk dosis selanjutnya. 


Manfaat Vaksin HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9)

  • Perlindungan terhadap kanker serviks – Mencegah infeksi HPV yang merupakan penyebab utama kanker serviks.
  • Mencegah kanker lainnya – Selain kanker serviks, HPV juga dapat menyebabkan kanker vulva, vagina, anus, penis, dan orofaring
  • Mencegah infeksi kutil kelamin yang disebabkan oleh virus HPV tipe 6 dan 11


Kandungan Vaksin HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9)

  • Protein rekombinan L1 dari HPV tipe 6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, 58.
  • Adjuvan: Aluminium Hidroksifosfat Sulfat Amorf (AAHS).
  • Bahan tambahan: natrium klorida, L-histidin, polisorbat 80, natrium borat, protein ragi, air untuk injeksi.
  • Produk bebas pengawet dan antibiotik.


Siapa yang Membutuhkan Vaksinasi HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9)

Sesuai pedoman IDAI & PAPDI:

  • Perempuan usia 9–45 tahun.
  • Laki-laki usia 9–26 tahun.
  • Idealnya diberikan sebelum aktif secara seksual untuk perlindungan maksimal.


Jadwal Vaksinasi HPV Nonavalen (Gardasil 9)

  • Usia 9–14 tahun: 2 dosis (jarak 6–12 bulan).
  • Usia 15–45 tahun (Perempuan) / 15–26 tahun (Laki-laki): 3 dosis (bulan ke-0, 2, 6).


Kontraindikasi

  • Riwayat alergi berat terhadap komponen vaksin atau dosis sebelumnya.
  • Tidak direkomendasikan untuk ibu hamil (konsultasi dokter).
  • Tunda jika sedang sakit akut sedang atau berat (misalnya demam tinggi).


Manufaktur

MSD


No. Registrasi BPOM

DKI1863501043A1

name: Glow Drip
description:
Glow Drip adalah infus yang mengandung 1000 mg asam askorbat atau vitamin C, dirancang untuk membantu memperbaiki kondisi kulit dan meningkatkan kesehatan tubuh secara umum.


Apa Manfaat Glow Drip?

  • Menjaga kesehatan kulit.
  • Membantu mencerahkan kulit.
  • Meningkatkan kelembapan kulit.
  • Membantu pembentukan kolagen untuk kulit yang lebih elastis dan kencang.
  • Membantu memperkuat sistem kekebalan tubuh.
  • Mencerahkan kulit dan mencegah kerusakan sel.

Pasien disarankan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan perawatan rutin kulit dan gaya hidup sehat untuk mendapatkan manfaat optimal dari Glow Drip.


Apa Isi Glow Drip?

Kandungan utama Glow Drip adalah 1000 mg asam askorbat (vitamin C).


Siapa yang Perlu Glow Drip?

  • Dewasa yang ingin membuat kulit tampil lebih cerah.
  • Dewasa yang membutuhkan tambahan vitamin C untuk memperkuat sistem kekebalan tubuh.


Kapan Sebaiknya Glow Drip Diberikan?

  • Infus dapat dilakukan setiap 2-4 minggu sekali untuk hasil optimal.
  • Frekuensi infus bisa disesuaikan berdasarkan anjuran dokter.


Kontraindikasi

Glow Drip tidak boleh diberikan kepada:

  • Individu yang alergi terhadap vitamin C .
  • Individu penderita gagal ginjal, batu ginjal, defisiensi G6PD, hemokromatosis, talasemia, leukemia, anemia sideroblastik.
  • Ibu hamil dan menyusui, kecuali dengan rekomendasi dari dokter kandungan atau dokter anak.
  • Individu yang mengonsumsi obat pengencer darah atau pil KB karena dapat meningkatkan risiko perdarahan serta menurunkan efektivitas pil KB.


Manufaktur

PT OTTO Pharmaceutical Industries

Administered in 2 doses, with an interval of 2 to 6 months between the first and second dose.

description:
Fasting Blood Sugar & 2-Hour Postprandial Glucose (PP) Check measures blood sugar levels in two key moments: while fasting (after 8–12 hours without food) and 2 hours after eating. It helps assess how the body processes glucose and detects blood sugar disorders like diabetes or prediabetes.

Benefits of Fasting Blood Sugar & 2-Hour Postprandial Glucose Check

  • Detects diabetes or prediabetes early
  • Monitors effectiveness of diabetes treatment
  • Prevents complications from high blood sugar
  • Shows how the body responds to glucose intake


Who Needs This Check?

  • Those with a family history of diabetes
  • People with obesity or inactive lifestyles
  • Diabetes patients monitoring their glucose
  • Pregnant women (gestational diabetes risk)
  • Anyone with symptoms like fatigue, frequent urination, or thirst


When Should This Check Be Done?

  • Regularly for high-risk individuals
  • When experiencing symptoms like blurred vision or weight loss
  • As part of routine health screening

Layanan ini menyediakan kunjungan dokter umum ke rumah untuk konsultasi tatap muka, pemeriksaan fisik, dan penanganan medis langsung. Dokter akan menilai kondisi pasien, meninjau riwayat medis, serta memberi rekomendasi yang sesuai — semua dilakukan di rumah atau lokasi pilihan Anda.


Apa yang Didapatkan dari Layanan Konsultasi dan Cek Fisik?

Pasien akan mendapatkan manfaat berikut:

  • Pemeriksaan fisik tatap muka untuk menilai kondisi secara keseluruhan
  • Pemeriksaan tanda vital seperti tekanan darah dan detak jantung
  • Diskusi tentang gejala atau perubahan kesehatan
  • Peninjauan riwayat kesehatan
  • Saran gaya hidup sehat atau perawatan pencegahan
  • Rujukan Tes Lab, Booster, atau resep obat jika diperlukan


Tambahan Layanan: Booster atau Tes Laboratorium

Pasien juga dapat menambahkan layanan Booster atau Tes Lab dalam kunjungan ini, sesuai dengan kebutuhan pasien yang direkomendasikan oleh dokter.

  • Layanan booster bertujuan untuk membantu memulihkan energi, meningkatkan daya tahan tubuh, serta mempercepat pemulihan melalui pemberian vitamin atau nutrisi secara langsung ke pembuluh darah.
  • Layanan Tes Laboratorium ditujukan untuk membantu dokter dalam menegakkan diagnosis dan memantau kondisi kesehatan pasien secara lebih akurat.

Seluruh tindakan, baik booster maupun pengambilan sampel untuk tes laboratorium, akan dilakukan oleh perawat terlatih di bawah pengawasan dokter.


Layanan Ini Direkomendasikan untuk Siapa?

Layanan ini cocok untuk siapa pun yang memerlukan pemeriksaan kesehatan yang praktis di rumah, seperti individu dengan jadwal yang padat sehingga sulit ke klinik atau RS, pasien dengan mobilitas terbatas, dan caregiver yang merawat anak kecil atau anggota keluarga lansia.

name: Consultation & Physical Examination
description:
This service provides a home visit by a general practitioner for in-person consultation, physical examination, and on-site medical care. The doctor will assess the patient’s health condition, review their medical history, and provide appropriate medical recommendations — all conducted in the comfort of your home or a location of your choice.


What are Provided in a Consultation and Physical Examination?

Through this service, patients will receive the following benefits:

  • Perform a physical examination in person to assess the patient's overall health
  • Check the patient's vital signs, such as blood pressure and heart rate
  • Discuss any symptoms or changes in the patient's health
  • Review the patient's medical history
  • Provide advice on healthy lifestyle choices or preventive care to support long-term health
  • If necessary, the doctor may recommend laboratory tests, booster treatments, or prescribe suitable medications.


Optional Add-Ons: Booster or Laboratory Tests

Patients may also opt to add Booster or Laboratory Test services during the visit, based on the doctor’s recommendation:

  • Booster treatments are designed to help restore energy, boost the immune system, and accelerate recovery through the direct infusion of vitamins or nutrients into the bloodstream.
  • Laboratory tests support doctors in making accurate diagnoses and monitoring the patient’s health more effectively.

All procedures, including booster administration and sample collection for lab tests, will be carried out by trained nurses under the supervision of a doctor.


Who is This Service Recommended For?

This service is for anyone who needs convenient health check-ups at home, such as individuals with busy schedules that make it hard to visit clinics or hospitals, patients with limited mobility, and caregivers caring for young children or elderly family members.


Note: The service fee does not include the cost of booster or laboratory tests. Additional charges will apply if the patient chooses to add these services.

- Prediksi gender janin

Tes NIPT Basic direkomendasikan untuk ibu hamil, terutama yang memiliki risiko lebih tinggi terhadap kelainan kromosom.

Tes NIPT Basic dapat dilakukan mulai dari kehamilan minggu ke-9.

name: NIPT Basic
description:
The Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing (NIPT) Basic Test is a pregnancy screening test aimed at detecting potential chromosomal abnormalities in the fetus.

This test is performed by analyzing the mother's blood, making it safe for the fetus.

By identifying health risks early, this test helps doctors plan appropriate care and interventions to ensure the well-being of both the mother and the baby.


What Are the Benefits of the NIPT Basic Test?

The NIPT Basic test provides safe and accurate information about the potential for chromosomal abnormalities in the fetus. This test includes:

- Assessing the risk of the fetus having:

  1. Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21)
  2. Edward Syndrome (Trisomy 18)
  3. Patau Syndrome (Trisomy 13)

- Predicting the fetal gender

- Maternal screening for genetic disorders: Alpha and Beta Thalassemia


Who Should Get the NIPT Basic Test?

NIPT Basic Test is recommended for pregnant women, especially those with a higher risk of chromosomal abnormalities.


When Is the NIPT Test Performed?

NIPT Basic Test can be performed starting from the 9th week of pregnancy.
preparation:
• The pregnancy must be at least 9 weeks.
  • No blood transfusions in the last 6 months.
  • Do not take blood thinners.
  • Do not take antibiotics or antivirals.
  • If you consume any routine medicines, continue to take them and inform our medical staff.
  • Wear loose clothes that can easily be rolled at the sleeves.

Mengapa Pemeriksaan Kehamilan Trimester 1 Itu Penting?

  • Deteksi dini gangguan kehamilan
  • Memastikan janin berkembang normal

Perkembangan Janin di Trimester Pertama

  • Minggu 1–4. Terjadi proses pembuahan dan implantasi. Kantung kehamilan mulai terbentuk, dan hormon kehamilan dapat terdeteksi.
  • Minggu 5–8. Jantung mulai berdetak. Pembentukan otak, tulang belakang, dan sistem saraf pusat dimulai. Tunas tangan dan kaki muncul.
  • Minggu 9–12. Wajah mulai terbentuk. Organ vital seperti hati, ginjal, dan paru-paru berkembang. Janin mulai bergerak meski belum terasa.

Di akhir trimester pertama, janin memiliki panjang sekitar 6–7 cm dan berat sekitar 14 gram. Pemeriksaan sejak dini penting untuk memastikan perkembangan janin berjalan normal.

Pada kehamilan trimester pertama, tubuh ibu mulai menyesuaikan diri dengan kehamilan. Beberapa perubahan umum yang dialami meliputi:

  • Mual dan muntah, terutama di pagi hari (morning sickness)
  • Kelelahan dan mengantuk berlebihan
  • Perubahan mood akibat fluktuasi hormon
  • Payudara terasa nyeri dan lebih sensitif
  • Sering buang air kecil

Why Are First Trimester Check-Ups Important?

  • Early detection of pregnancy-related complications
  • Ensuring normal fetal development
  • Identifying infections or high-risk medical conditions
  • Estimating the expected date of delivery (EDD)


Fetal Development in the First Trimester

  • Weeks 1–4: Fertilization and implantation occur. The gestational sac begins to form, and pregnancy hormones become detectable.
  • Weeks 5–8: The heart begins to beat. Development of the brain, spinal cord, and central nervous system begins. Limb buds appear.
  • Weeks 9–12: The face starts to form. Vital organs such as the liver, kidneys, and lungs begin developing. The baby starts to move, though movements are not yet felt.

By the end of the first trimester, the fetus measures approximately 6–7 cm in length and weighs around 14 grams. Early check-ups are important to ensure proper fetal development.


Changes in the Mother During the First Trimester

During this phase, the mother’s body begins adjusting to pregnancy. Common symptoms include:

  • Nausea and vomiting, especially in the morning (morning sickness)
  • Fatigue and excessive sleepiness
  • Mood swings due to hormonal changes
  • Tender and more sensitive breasts
  • Frequent urination
  • Changes in sense of smell and appetite

Second trimester pregnancy check-ups (weeks 13–27) help detect health risks like anemia, diabetes, vitamin D deficiency, electrolyte or kidney disorders, thyroid hormone imbalances, and infections that may affect fetal health. This package includes an AFP (Alpha-Fetoprotein) test, recommended in weeks 15–20, to screen for fetal abnormalities like Down syndrome and spina bifida. Abnormal results may require follow-up tests such as NIPT.

Why Second Trimester Pregnancy Check-Ups Are Important

  • To ensure the baby’s growth matches the gestational age
  • To detect birth defects or chromosomal abnormalities through screening
  • To monitor blood pressure and signs of preeclampsia
  • To perform a complete fetal anatomy ultrasound
  • To identify the placenta’s position and the amount of amniotic fluid


Fetal Development in the Second Trimester

  • Weeks 13–16: The baby begins moving its arms and legs. Bones continue to harden and facial features become more defined.
  • Weeks 17–20: The mother starts feeling fetal movements (quickening). The baby’s hearing begins to develop and the gender can often be seen via ultrasound.
  • Weeks 21–27: The baby’s organs develop more completely. Lungs begin to form, and the baby starts responding to sounds from outside the womb.


Changes in the Mother During the Second Trimester

  • Belly starts to enlarge as the baby grows
  • Nausea and vomiting usually begin to subside
  • Breasts become larger and more sensitive
  • Stretch marks may appear on the abdomen, thighs, or breasts
  • Increased appetite and energy levels
  • May experience back pain, leg cramps, or mild swelling

name: Third Trimester Pregnancy Package
description:
The third-trimester pregnancy check-up package (weeks 28–40) helps ensure the mother is in optimal condition for delivery. It screens for anemia and infections and ensures normal blood clotting function.

Entering the third trimester, pregnant mothers should be more alert about physical changes and the baby’s development, as this phase prepares the body for labor.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost.

✅100% performed by Specialised Vaccination Doctors

✅Bonus Chat Doctor Coupon after the procedure


Why Third Trimester Check-Ups Are Important

The third trimester is the final stage of pregnancy and requires closer monitoring:

  • Monitor baby and placenta position
  • Assess amniotic fluid levels
  • Ensure baby’s growth and heartbeat
  • Detect preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, or infections early
  • Evaluate cervix readiness for labor
  • Determine suitable delivery method


Fetal Development in the Third Trimester

The baby’s organs mature and body weight increases significantly:

  • Weeks 28–32: Lungs and nervous system develop. The baby opens/closes eyes and has sleep-wake patterns.
  • Weeks 33–36: Baby gains weight, movements strengthen, and head moves into the pelvis.
  • Weeks 37–40: Baby is full-term, organs function fully, and birth weight is around 2.5–3.5 kg.


Changes in the Mother During the Third Trimester

  • Belly becomes larger and heavier
  • Back pain and pelvic discomfort
  • Difficulty sleeping and frequent urination at night
  • Feelings of anxiety approaching delivery
  • Mild swelling in the hands and feet
  • False contractions (Braxton Hicks) may begin


It is important for the mother to maintain a healthy diet, get enough rest, and undergo regular check-ups to prepare optimally for childbirth.

description:
The RSV Vaccine (Arexvy) is used to protect adults from infection with the Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). RSV can cause serious lung and respiratory tract infections, especially in the elderly and individuals with certain medical conditions. This vaccine helps the body build immunity to reduce the risk of complications from RSV infection.

  • Prevent RSV infections that can cause serious respiratory illnesses.
  • Reduce the risk of complications such as pneumonia and bronchiolitis.
  • Protect vulnerable groups, including the elderly and individuals with chronic diseases.
  • Reduce hospitalization rates due to RSV infection in high-risk adults.


Vaccine Composition

  • Antigen: Recombinant RSV F glycoprotein stabilized in the prefusion conformation (RSVPreF3)
  • Adjuvant: AS01E adjuvant system, which includes plant extract QS-21 and MPL (from Salmonella minnesota)

Vaksin ini mengandung strain nonaktif:

  • Virus mirip A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09 (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA

description:
The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) provides active protection against H3N2 and H1N1 (Influenza type A) as well as Victoria and Yamagata (Influenza type B), which can cause various upper respiratory infections, pneumonia, sinusitis, and ear infections.


What Are the Benefits of Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Protects against common influenza strains
  • Reduces risk of complications from influenza infections


What’s in the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

The vaccine contains inactivated strains:

  • A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2)-like virus (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • B/Washington/02/2019-like virus (B/Washington/02/2019, wild type) 15 µg HA
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like virus (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type) 15 µg HA

Propagated in fertilized hens' eggs.


Who Should Receive Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

It is recommended for adults and children from 6 months of age.


When Is the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) Given?

  • First-time vaccination for children aged 6 months - 8 years: 2 doses with a 28-day interval, followed by annual doses for full protection.
  • Adults and children aged 9 years and above: 1 dose annually for full protection.

Administered via intramuscular injection.


Contraindications

The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) should not be given to:

  • Infants under 6 months
  • Individuals allergic to any vaccine components, including egg protein (ovalbumin, chicken protein), neomycin, formaldehyde, or octoxynol-9
  • Individuals with a history of severe allergic reactions to Influenza vaccines


Important

  • The Influenza vaccine can be administered alongside other vaccines at different injection sites.
  • This vaccine is safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women.
  • Delay vaccination if the patient has a fever ≥38°C, seizures, acute infections, or if the schedule does not meet the necessary interval.

Anti Hangover Drip is an intravenous infusion of electrolytes and vitamins designed to prevent and alleviate hangover symptoms caused by alcohol consumption. It helps accelerate recovery by providing hydration, relieving nausea and vomiting, and restoring electrolyte balance.


What Are the Benefits of the Anti Hangover Drip?

  • Helps prevent and relieve hangover symptoms.
  • Restores hydration levels and balances electrolytes.
  • Reduces nausea and vomiting after alcohol consumption.
  • May minimize the negative effects of alcohol on the body and brain.


What’s in the Anti Hangover Drip?

  • Proton pump inhibitors and antiemetics.
  • Electrolytes.
  • Vitamin B complex.


When Should You Get an Anti Hangover Drip?

  • Before drinking: Administered 1-3 hours before alcohol consumption to aid liver alcohol metabolism and prevent dizziness, fatigue, and weakness.
  • After drinking: Given as soon as hangover symptoms appear to prevent worsening.


Precautions

  • If experiencing severe hangover symptoms and moderate-to-severe dehydration, seek immediate medical care.
  • No supplement or medication completely prevents or cures a hangover. The best prevention is limiting alcohol intake and staying hydrated.
  • Patients with a hangover condition must be accompanied by a guardian or family member.


Contraindications

The Anti Hangover Drip should not be administered to:

  • Individuals under 18 years old.
  • Patients allergic to any of the drip’s ingredients.
  • Patients with severe liver or kidney dysfunction.
  • Patients with untreated severe electrolyte imbalances.
  • Patients with moderate-to-severe dehydration and severe hangover symptoms.
  • Patients with decreased consciousness.
  • Patients displaying aggressive behavior.

description:
Pemeriksaan Nutrigenomic adalah tes genetik untuk melihat bagaimana variasi genetik memengaruhi respons individu terhadap metabolisme, nutrisi dan olah raga.


Apa manfaat tes ini?

Untuk melihat kebutuhan nutrisi, olah raga, respons tubuh terhadap makanan serta risiko penyakit metabolik secara personal, antara lain:

  1. Respon tubuh terhadap karbohidrat, lemak, dan protein
  2. Intoleransi terhadap laktosa, gluten, dan kafein
  3. Risiko gangguan tidur
  4. Fungsi detoksifikasi
  5. Level hormon
  6. Kebutuhan olahraga
  7. Risiko penyakit kardiovaskular, diabetes dan obesitas


Apa saja yang diperiksa?

Ada 12 panel yang diperiksa, dengan 78 parameter yang meliputi 104 gen

Berikut 12 panel dalam NutriGEN-ME LIFE:

  1. Kebutuhan Vitamin dan Mineral
  2. Intoleransi Makanan
  3. Metabolisme Lipid
  4. Sensitivitas Insulin
  5. Manajemen Berat Badan dan Komposisi Tubuh
  6. Pola Makan
  7. Fisiologi Olahraga dan Kebugaran
  8. Kesehatan Tulang dan Sendi
  9. Peradangan
  10. Stres Oksidatif
  11. Metilasi
  12. Hormon dan Detoksifikasi


Siapa yang perlu tes NutriGEN-ME LIFE?

Tes ini cocok untuk semua usia, untuk mereka yang mempunyai tujuan memperbaiki gaya hidup demi kesehatan yang lebih baik.


Tes ini sudah termasuk konsultasi dengan dokter untuk pembacaan hasil, dengan durasi maksimal 30 menit.

name: Nutrigenomic Test (Nutrigenme Kalbe)
description:
Nutrigenomic Test is a genetic test designed to analyze how genetic variations influence an individual's response to metabolism, nutrition, and exercise.


What are the Benefits of NutriGEN-ME LIFE?

This test helps assess personal nutritional needs, exercise requirements, the body's response to food, and the risk of metabolic diseases, including:

  1. Body response to carbohydrates, fats, and proteins  
  2. Intolerance to lactose, gluten, and caffeine  
  3. Sleep disorder risks  
  4. Detoxification function  
  5. Hormone levels  
  6. Exercise requirements  
  7. Risk of cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and obesity


What does NutriGEN-ME LIFE contains?

The test analyzes 12 panels with 78 parameters covering 104 genes.

Here are the 12 panels included in NutriGEN-ME LIFE:

  1. Vitamin and Mineral Requirements  
  2. Food Intolerances  
  3. Lipid Metabolism  
  4. Insulin Sensitivity  
  5. Weight and Body Composition Management  
  6. Dietary Patterns  
  7. Exercise Physiology and Fitness  
  8. Bone and Joint Health  
  9. Inflammation  
  10. Oxidative Stress  
  11. Methylation  
  12. Hormones and Detoxification


Who should get NutriGEN-ME LIFE?

This test is suitable for all ages and is ideal for individuals looking to improve their lifestyle for better overall health.


The test includes a consultation with a doctor for result interpretation, with a maximum duration of 30 minutes.

Quadrivalent Influenza Vaccine (Fluarix Tetra) is an inactivated influenza vaccine that protects against four influenza virus strains (two A types and two B types) based on WHO recommendations for the current season.

Benefits of Influenza Vaccination (Fluarix Tetra)

  • Influenza Prevention: Helps provide immunity against influenza caused by the virus strains in the vaccine.
  • Complication Prevention: Reduces the risk of severe flu-related complications such as pneumonia, bronchitis, sinus infections, and worsening of chronic conditions.


Contents of Influenza Vaccine (Fluarix Tetra)

  • Inactivated influenza virus antigens (split virion) from four strains based on WHO recommendations for the season (type A(H1N1), type A(H3N2), and two type B strains from the Yamagata and Victoria lineages).
  • Other ingredients include sodium chloride, various phosphate salts, polysorbate 80, and water for injections.


Who Needs the Influenza Vaccination (Fluarix Tetra)

  • Infants and children aged 6 months and older
  • All adults
  • Especially recommended for high-risk groups: young children (6 months–5 years), the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases


Influenza Vaccination Schedule (Fluarix Tetra)

  • Single dose annually
  • Children aged 6 months to 8 years receiving it for the first time need 2 doses, at least 4 weeks apart


Contraindications

  • Severe allergy (hypersensitivity) to Fluarix Tetra or any previous influenza vaccine
  • Vaccination should be delayed in cases of severe fever-related illness (mild cold is not a contraindication)

  • Perlindungan dari Pneumonia. Mencegah infeksi paru-paru serius yang dapat berakibat fatal.
  • Mengurangi Risiko Meningitis. Mencegah meningitis / peradangan pada selaput otak yang disebabkan oleh bakteri pneumokokus.

  • Polisakarida dari Streptococcus pneumoniae serotipe 1, 4, 5, 6B, 7F, 9V, 14, 18C, 19F and 23F
  • Dikonjugasikan ke protein pembawa berupa protein D (berasal dari Haemophilus influenzae tipe non-tipikal/NTHi),

description:
Pneumonia vaccine PPSV23 (Pneumovax 23) protects adults aged 50+ from pneumococcal disease caused by 23 types of Streptococcus pneumoniae. This bacterium can lead to serious illnesses like pneumonia, meningitis (brain lining inflammation), and sepsis (blood infection).


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅100% performed by Vaccination Specialist Doctors

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


What Are the Benefits of PPSV23 Vaccination (Pneumovax 23)?

  • Prevents Pneumococcal Pneumonia: Reduces the risk of lung infections caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae.
  • Prevents Invasive Pneumococcal Disease (IPD): Protects against severe illnesses like meningitis and bloodstream infections.
  • Broad Coverage: Protects against 23 serotypes included in the vaccine.


What Does (Pneumovax 23) Vaccination Contain?

Each 0.5 ml dose contains:

  • Purified polysaccharides from 23 serotypes of S. pneumoniae (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6B, 7F, 8, 9N, 9V, 10A, 11A, 12F, 14, 15B, 17F, 18C, 19F, 19A, 20, 22F, 23F, 33F)
  • Isotonic saline with 0.25% phenol as preservative


Who Should Get (Pneumovax 23) Vaccination?

Recommended for:

  • Adults aged 50 years and older
  • Immunocompromised individuals, who are more at risk for infection from strains not covered by PCV13/PCV15
  • Hajj and Umrah pilgrims to ensure protection before travel


When Should (Pneumovax 23) Vaccination Be Given?

  • One dose for adults aged ≥50
  • If previously received a PCV vaccine, may be given after at least 1 year


What Is the Schedule for Individuals Who Have Never Received a Pneumococcal Vaccine?

  • If unvaccinated: PPSV23 can be given immediately
  • If PCV13/PCV15/PCV20 was received first: wait 1 year before giving PPSV23
  • If PPSV23 was given first: PCV13/PCV13/PCV15 may be given after at least 1 year


Contraindications

  • Severe allergic reaction to any vaccine component
  • Delay if patient has high fever or acute infection

description:

1 booking only includes 1 dose. You are required to create a new booking for your next dose.


What Are the Benefits of DTaP-POLIO IPV-HIB (Infanrix IPV Hib)?

  • Protects children from five dangerous diseases.
  • Prevents serious complications such as paralysis (polio) and respiratory infections (HIB).
  • Reduces disease transmission in the community (herd immunity).
  • Minimizes the number of injections required for children.


What Does DTaP-POLIO IPV-HIB (Infanrix IPV Hib) Contain?

  • Diphtheria & Tetanus Toxoid: Prevents diphtheria and tetanus.
  • Acellular Pertussis Antigen: Protects against whooping cough.
  • Inactivated Poliovirus (IPV): Prevents polio.
  • HIB Vaccine: Protects against Haemophilus influenzae type b infections.


When Should DTaP-POLIO IPV-HIB (Infanrix IPV Hib) Be Given?

  • Dose 1: 2 months
  • Dose 2: 3 or 4 months
  • Dose 3: 4 or 6 months
  • Booster: 18 months


Who Should Get DTaP-POLIO IPV-HIB (Infanrix IPV Hib) Vaccination?

  • Infants and children from 2 months old, with subsequent doses at 3 and 4 months or 4 and 6 months, and a booster dose at 18 months.
  • Children who missed their scheduled vaccinations, as advised by healthcare professionals.


Contraindications

Not recommended for individuals with:

  • Severe allergic reactions to vaccine components.
  • Encephalopathy within 7 days of a previous DTaP dose.
  • Brain or nerve disorders after a diphtheria/tetanus vaccination.
  • Individuals older than 5 years old.

description:
Vaksin Fluarix Tetra adalah vaksin influenza quadrivalent (empat strain) untuk digunakan pada orang dewasa dan anak-anak dari usia 6 bulan untuk mencegah influenza (flu) yang disebabkan oleh virus influenza tipe A dan B.


Apa Isi Vaksin Flu (Fluarix Tetra)?

Vaksin ini mengandung antigen virus influenza dari strain berikut:

  • A/Victoria/4897/2022 (H1N1)pdm09-like strain (A/Victoria/4897/2022, IVR-238); 
  • A/Thailand/8/2022 (H3N2)-like strain (A/Thailand/8/2022, IVR-237); 
  • B/Austria/1359417/2021-like strain (B/Austria/1359417/2021, BVR-26); 
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like strain (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type).


Apa Manfaat Vaksin Flu (Fluarix Tetra)?

Fluarix Tetra Vaccination is a quadrivalent influenza vaccine designed to help protect against influenza virus infections. It contains four inactivated influenza virus strains: two influenza A strains (H1N1 and H3N2) and two influenza B strains.


What Does the Influenza Vaccine Contain?

This vaccine contains influenza virus antigens from the following strains:

  • A/Victoria/4897/2022 (H1N1)pdm09-like strain (A/Victoria/4897/2022, IVR-238)
  • A/Thailand/8/2022 (H3N2)-like strain (A/Thailand/8/2022, IVR-237)
  • B/Austria/1359417/2021-like strain (B/Austria/1359417/2021, BVR-26)
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like strain (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type)


What Are the Benefits of Influenza Vaccination (Fluarix Tetra)?

  • Prevents influenza caused by influenza A and B viruses contained in the vaccine.
  • Reduces the risk of serious complications from influenza, especially in vulnerable groups such as children, the elderly, pregnant women, and individuals with certain medical conditions.


Who Should Receive the Influenza Vaccine (Fluarix Tetra)?

  • Children & adolescents from 6 months of age
  • Adults. Adults with comorbid conditions (such as chronic kidney disease, chronic heart disease, and diabetes mellitus)
  • Elderly individuals
  • Pregnant and breastfeeding women


When Should the Influenza Vaccine (Fluarix Tetra) be Given (According to IDAI and PAPDI)?

  • Children aged 6 months - 8 years: 2 doses with a 4-week interval, followed by 1 dose annually.
  • Children aged 9 years and above: 1 dose annually.
  • Adults: 1 dose annually.


Contraindications

Fluarix Tetra should not be administered to individuals who:

  • Have hypersensitivity to any component of the vaccine.
  • Have a history of allergic reactions after receiving Fluarix Tetra or other influenza vaccines.
  • Are experiencing a fever ≥ 38°C or other acute medical conditions.
  • Are under 6 months of age.

Vaccines for adults and children from 6 months of age.

The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) provides active protection against H3N2 and H1N1 (Influenza type A) as well as Victoria and Yamagata (Influenza type B), which can cause various upper respiratory infections, pneumonia, sinusitis, and ear infections.


What Are the Benefits of Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Protects against common influenza strains
  • Reduces risk of complications from influenza infections


What’s in the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

The vaccine contains inactivated strains:

  • A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2)-like virus (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • B/Washington/02/2019-like virus (B/Washington/02/2019, wild type) 15 µg HA
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like virus (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type) 15 µg HA

Propagated in fertilized hens' eggs.


Who Should Receive Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaccines for adults and children from 6 months of age.


When Is the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) Given?

  • First-time vaccination for children aged 6 months - 8 years: 2 doses with a 28-day interval, followed by annual doses for full protection.
  • Adults and children aged 9 years and above: 1 dose annually for full protection.

Administered via intramuscular injection.


Contraindications

The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) should not be given to:

  • Infants under 6 months
  • Individuals allergic to any vaccine components, including egg protein (ovalbumin, chicken protein), neomycin, formaldehyde, or octoxynol-9
  • Individuals with a history of severe allergic reactions to Influenza vaccines


Important

  • The Influenza vaccine can be administered alongside other vaccines at different injection sites.
  • This vaccine is safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women.
  • Delay vaccination if the patient has a fever ≥38°C, seizures, acute infections, or if the schedule does not meet the necessary interval.

name: Vaksinasi Influenza (Vaxigrip Tetra) - PT IAMI
description:
Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra) memberikan perlindungan terhadap virus H3N2 dan H1N1 (Influenza tipe A) serta Victoria dan Yamagata (Influenza tipe B), yang dapat menyebabkan infeksi saluran pernapasan atas, pneumonia, sinusitis, dan infeksi telinga.


Apa Saja Manfaat Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Melindungi dari varian influenza umum
  • Mengurangi risiko komplikasi akibat infeksi influenza


Apa Isi Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaksin ini mengandung strain nonaktif:

  • Virus mirip A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09 (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2) (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip B/Washington/02/2019 (B/Washington/02/2019, tipe liar) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip B/Phuket/3073/2013 (B/Phuket/3073/2013, tipe liar) 15 µg HA

Dikembangkan dalam telur ayam.


Siapa yang Perlu Mendapatkan Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaksin untuk dewasa dan anak-anak mulai usia 6 bulan.


Kapan Jadwal Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra) Diberikan?

  • Anak usia 6 bulan-8 tahun (dosis pertama): 2 dosis dengan interval 28 hari, lalu diulang setiap tahun.
  • Anak usia 9 tahun ke atas dan pasien dewasa: 1 dosis setiap tahun.

Vaksin diberikan melalui suntikan intramuskular.


Kontraindikasi

Vaksin tidak boleh diberikan kepada:

  • Bayi di bawah 6 bulan
  • Individu alergi terhadap komponen vaksin (protein telur, neomisin, formaldehida, atau oktoksinol-9)
  • Pasien dengan riwayat alergi berat terhadap vaksin Influenza


Penting

  • Vaksin Influenza dapat diberikan bersamaan dengan vaksin lain di lokasi suntikan berbeda.
  • Aman untuk ibu hamil dan menyusui.
  • Tunda vaksinasi jika demam ≥38°C, kejang, infeksi akut, atau jadwal tidak sesuai interval yang diperlukan.

name: Pemeriksaan Fisik - Walkin
description:
Physical Examination

A physical examination is a comprehensive evaluation of a patient’s physical condition conducted by a doctor to identify health issues, establish a diagnosis, or monitor the progression of a disease.


What Are the Benefits of a General Practitioner’s Physical Examination?

  • Understanding overall health status
  • Early detection of diseases or health disorders
  • Diagnosing based on symptoms and clinical signs
  • Determining an appropriate treatment plan
  • Monitoring the effectiveness of therapy
  • Required for medical check-ups or health certificates


What Is Involved in a General Practitioner’s Physical Examination?

Vital Sign Measurements:

  • Blood pressure
  • Pulse rate
  • Respiratory rate
  • Body temperature

Head-to-Toe Examination:

  • Head & Neck: Scalp, hair, face, lymph nodes, thyroid
  • Chest & Lungs: Breath sounds, chest structure
  • Heart: Rhythm, abnormalities
  • Abdomen: Palpation for tenderness, organ size
  • Limbs: Muscle strength, reflexes, joint mobility

Special Examinations (if needed):

  • Skin: Rashes, wounds, signs of skin disease
  • Ears, Nose, and Throat: Using special instruments
  • Additional exams according to the patient’s complaints

description:
Thoracic Radiology Examination

A thoracic radiology examination is a diagnostic method that uses X-rays to produce detailed images of the chest, including the lungs, heart, ribs, and other thoracic structures. This examination helps doctors diagnose medical conditions related to these organs.


What Are the Benefits of a Thoracic Radiology Examination?

  • Diagnosis of Lung Diseases: Pneumonia, Tuberculosis (TB), Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), lung tumors/cancer
  • Identification of Heart Problems: Heart enlargement (cardiomegaly), pericardial effusion
  • Detection of Trauma or Injuries: Rib fractures, lung injuries
  • Evaluation of Other Conditions: Pleural effusion, diaphragmatic disorders


How Is a Thoracic Radiology Examination Performed?

  • The patient is asked to stand or lie down, depending on the requirement
  • Instructions are given to hold their breath briefly during the imaging
  • Images are taken from the front (PA – posteroanterior) and/or the side (lateral)
  • The procedure only takes a few minutes


Who Should Undergo a Thoracic Radiology Examination?

  • Patients with chronic cough, shortness of breath, or chest pain
  • Individuals exposed to infectious diseases such as TB
  • Those who have experienced chest trauma
  • Patients needing further evaluation of lung or heart conditions


When Should a Thoracic Radiology Examination Be Conducted?

  • As recommended by a doctor, especially when symptoms related to the lungs, heart, or chest injury are present


Contraindications

  • Not recommended for pregnant women (unless in a medical emergency with proper protection)
  • Patients allergic to contrast agents (if used)


Important Notes

  • Non-invasive and painless procedure
  • Uses low-dose X-ray radiation, generally safe for most people
  • Pregnant women must inform the medical staff beforehand
  • Patients should bring a referral and complete medical history for optimal evaluation

Manfaat Vaksin Influenza (Flubio)

  • Mencegah Influenza. Flubio membantu mencegah infeksi virus influenza yang dapat menyebabkan demam tinggi, batuk, pilek, dan nyeri otot.
  • Mengurangi Risiko Komplikasi. Vaksin ini dapat mengurangi kemungkinan komplikasi serius seperti pneumonia, infeksi telinga, sinusitis, atau bahkan peradangan otak.
  • Perlindungan bagi Kelompok Rentan. Individu dengan sistem imun lemah, seperti anak-anak, lansia, ibu hamil, serta penderita penyakit kronis.


Kandungan Vaksin Influenza (Flubio)

  • Antigen virus influenza inaktif (HA) dari tiga strain sesuai rekomendasi WHO untuk musim tersebut (tipe A(H1N1), tipe A(H3N2), dan satu tipe B). 
  • Mengandung Thimerosal sebagai pengawet. 
  • Vaksin influenza umumnya ditumbuhkan pada telur dan mungkin mengandung sisa protein telur.


Siapa yang Membutuhkan Vaksinasi Influenza (Flubio)

  • Bayi dan anak usia 6 bulan ke atas.
  • Disarankan untuk kelompok berisiko tinggi: anak 6 bulan–5 tahun, lansia, ibu hamil, penderita penyakit kronis, tenaga kesehatan, calon jemaah haji/umrah.


Jadwal Vaksinasi Influenza (Flubio)

  • Dosis tunggal tiap tahun.
  • Anak usia 6 bulan–8 tahun yang baru pertama kali vaksin perlu 2 dosis, jarak minimal 4 minggu.


Kontraindikasi

Riwayat alergi berat terhadap vaksin influenza sebelumnya atau terhadap komponen seperti Thimerosal atau protein telur.

description:
Influenza Vaccine (Flubio) is an influenza vaccine that helps protect the body from influenza virus infection by boosting the immune system. Influenza may cause mild to severe symptoms and serious complications like pneumonia, especially in vulnerable groups such as children and the elderly.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

Benefits of Influenza Vaccine (Flubio)

  • Prevents Influenza: Helps prevent flu symptoms such as high fever, cough, runny nose, and muscle aches.
  • Reduces Risk of Complications: Lowers the chance of pneumonia, ear infections, sinusitis, or brain inflammation.
  • Protection for Vulnerable Groups: Ideal for children, elderly, pregnant women, and people with chronic conditions.


Vaccine Content of Influenza (Flubio)

  • Inactivated influenza virus antigens (HA) from three strains recommended by the WHO for the season (type A(H1N1), type A(H3N2), and one type B).
  • Contains thimerosal as a preservative.
  • Influenza vaccines are generally grown in eggs and may contain residual egg proteins.


Who Needs Influenza Vaccination (Flubio)

  • Infants and children aged 6 months and older.
  • Highly recommended for high-risk groups (e.g., children aged 6 months–5 years, the elderly, pregnant women, individuals with chronic illnesses, healthcare workers, and prospective Hajj/Umrah pilgrims).


Vaccination Schedule for Influenza (Flubio)

  • 1 dose yearly.
  • Children 6 months–8 years getting the vaccine for the first time need 2 doses, 4 weeks apart.


Contraindications

  • History of hypersensitivity (severe allergy) after a previous influenza vaccination or to any component of the vaccine (including thimerosal or egg components if relevant to the production process).

Apa Saja Manfaat Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Melindungi dari varian influenza umum
  • Mengurangi risiko komplikasi akibat infeksi influenza


Apa Isi Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaksin ini mengandung strain nonaktif:

  • Virus mirip A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09 (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2) (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip B/Washington/02/2019 (B/Washington/02/2019, tipe liar) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip B/Phuket/3073/2013 (B/Phuket/3073/2013, tipe liar) 15 µg HA

Dikembangkan dalam telur ayam.


Siapa yang Perlu Mendapatkan Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaksin untuk dewasa dan anak-anak mulai usia 6 bulan.


Kapan Jadwal Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra) Diberikan?

  • Anak usia 6 bulan-8 tahun (dosis pertama): 2 dosis dengan interval 28 hari, lalu diulang setiap tahun.
  • Anak usia 9 tahun ke atas dan pasien dewasa: 1 dosis setiap tahun.

Vaksin diberikan melalui suntikan intramuskular.


Kontraindikasi

Vaksin tidak boleh diberikan kepada:

  • Bayi di bawah 6 bulan
  • Individu alergi terhadap komponen vaksin (protein telur, neomisin, formaldehida, atau oktoksinol-9)
  • Pasien dengan riwayat alergi berat terhadap vaksin Influenza


Penting

  • Vaksin Influenza dapat diberikan bersamaan dengan vaksin lain di lokasi suntikan berbeda.
  • Aman untuk ibu hamil dan menyusui.
  • Tunda vaksinasi jika demam ≥38°C, kejang, infeksi akut, atau jadwal tidak sesuai interval yang diperlukan.

description:
The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) provides active protection against H3N2 and H1N1 (Influenza type A) as well as Victoria and Yamagata (Influenza type B), which can cause various upper respiratory infections, pneumonia, sinusitis, and ear infections.


What Are the Benefits of Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Protects against common influenza strains
  • Reduces risk of complications from influenza infections


What’s in the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

The vaccine contains inactivated strains:

  • A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2)-like virus (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • B/Washington/02/2019-like virus (B/Washington/02/2019, wild type) 15 µg HA
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like virus (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type) 15 µg HA

Propagated in fertilized hens' eggs.


Who Should Receive Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaccines for adults and children from 6 months of age.


When Is the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) Given?

  • First-time vaccination for children aged 6 months - 8 years: 2 doses with a 28-day interval, followed by annual doses for full protection.
  • Adults and children aged 9 years and above: 1 dose annually for full protection.

Administered via intramuscular injection.


Contraindications

The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) should not be given to:

  • Infants under 6 months
  • Individuals allergic to any vaccine components, including egg protein (ovalbumin, chicken protein), neomycin, formaldehyde, or octoxynol-9
  • Individuals with a history of severe allergic reactions to Influenza vaccines


Important

  • The Influenza vaccine can be administered alongside other vaccines at different injection sites.
  • This vaccine is safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women.
  • Delay vaccination if the patient has a fever ≥38°C, seizures, acute infections, or if the schedule does not meet the necessary interval.

Pemeriksaan kesehatan yang lengkap untuk memeriksa kesehatanmu secara menyeluruh. Meliputi tes lab, dan pemeriksaan non-lab yang menggunakan sampel darah.

Paket ini direkomendasikan untuk memeriksa kondisi kesehatan karyawan.
preparation:
• Puasa tidak makan selama 9 - 12 jam sebelum tindakan. Selama berpuasa, tidak diperbolehkan makan, hanya diperbolehkan minum air putih.

  • Mengenakan pakaian yang mudah dilipat pada bagian lengan.
test_sample: • Darah yang diambil dari pembuluh darah vena pada lengan.
terms_conditions:
Tentang Homecare

  • Setelah kamu memesan via aplikasi Halodoc, Admin Homecare akan mengonfirmasi pesanan melalui WhatsApp.
  • Pastikan profil yang dipilih sesuai dengan pasien yang menjalani tindakan. Pilih atau buat profil di halaman ‘Keranjang’.
  • Homecare disarankan dilakukan di rumah atau lokasi bersih yang mudah diakses.
  • Dapatkan informasi lebih lanjut untuk tindakan melalui Official WhatsApp Homecare 0888-0999-9226.

Harga & Biaya Transpor

  • Harga mencakup layanan, APD, dan kupon konsultasi Rp25.000 (dikirim melalui WhatsApp setelah hasil tes tersedia atau tindakan selesai).
  • Gratis biaya transpor staf medis dengan minimum pemesanan Rp250.000 (biaya transpor berlaku di Jabodetabek).

Pembatalan & Pengubahan Jadwal

  • Waktu tindakan bisa dipengaruhi oleh ketersediaan staf medis, cuaca, atau faktor lainnya.
  • Pembatalan dan pengubahan jadwal dapat dilakukan melalui aplikasi Halodoc dan Admin Homecare paling lambat 24 jam sebelum jadwal awal.

Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra) memberikan perlindungan terhadap virus H3N2 dan H1N1 (Influenza tipe A) serta Victoria dan Yamagata (Influenza tipe B), yang dapat menyebabkan infeksi saluran pernapasan atas, pneumonia, sinusitis, dan infeksi telinga.

Apa Isi Vaksin Flu (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaksin ini mengandung strain nonaktif:

  • Virus mirip A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09 (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2) (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • Virus mirip B/Washington/02/2019 (B/Washington/02/2019, tipe liar) 15 µg HA

Dikembangkan dalam telur ayam.

Vaksin untuk dewasa dan anak-anak mulai usia 6 bulan.

  • Anak usia 6 bulan-8 tahun (dosis pertama): 2 dosis dengan interval 28 hari, lalu diulang setiap tahun.

Vaksin diberikan melalui suntikan intramuskular.

Vaksin tidak boleh diberikan kepada:

  • Bayi di bawah 6 bulan
  • Individu alergi terhadap komponen vaksin (protein telur, neomisin, formaldehida, atau oktoksinol-9)

name: Influenza Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) - Zurich
description:
The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) provides active protection against H3N2 and H1N1 (Influenza type A) as well as Victoria and Yamagata (Influenza type B), which can cause various upper respiratory infections, pneumonia, sinusitis, and ear infections.


What Are the Benefits of Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Protects against common influenza strains
  • Reduces risk of complications from influenza infections


What’s in the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

The vaccine contains inactivated strains:

  • A/Victoria/2570/2019 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus (A/Victoria/2570/2019, IVR-215) 15 µg HA
  • A/Cambodia/e0826360/2020 (H3N2)-like virus (A/Tasmania/503/2020, IVR-221) 15 µg HA
  • B/Washington/02/2019-like virus (B/Washington/02/2019, wild type) 15 µg HA
  • B/Phuket/3073/2013-like virus (B/Phuket/3073/2013, wild type) 15 µg HA

Propagated in fertilized hens' eggs.


Who Should Receive Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

Vaccines for adults and children from 6 months of age.


When Is the Flu Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) Given?

  • First-time vaccination for children aged 6 months - 8 years: 2 doses with a 28-day interval, followed by annual doses for full protection.
  • Adults and children aged 9 years and above: 1 dose annually for full protection.

Administered via intramuscular injection.


Contraindications

The Flu Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) should not be given to:

  • Infants under 6 months
  • Individuals allergic to any vaccine components, including egg protein (ovalbumin, chicken protein), neomycin, formaldehyde, or octoxynol-9
  • Individuals with a history of severe allergic reactions to Influenza vaccines


Important

  • The Influenza vaccine can be administered alongside other vaccines at different injection sites.
  • This vaccine is safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women.
  • Delay vaccination if the patient has a fever ≥38°C, seizures, acute infections, or if the schedule does not meet the necessary interval.

Infus drip paracetamol mengandung paracetamol 1.000 mg / 100 ml

name: Influenza Vaccination (Vaxigrip Tetra) - Generali (DBS)
description:
Influenza Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) is a quadrivalent vaccine used to protect against four types of influenza viruses. This flu vaccine provides protection against H3N2 and H1N1 viruses (Influenza type A) as well as Victoria and Yamagata (Influenza type B), which can cause upper respiratory tract infections, pneumonia, sinusitis, and ear infections.


✅Provided at home (home service) / from anywhere with Homecare by Halodoc service at no additional cost

✅100% performed by Vaccination Specialist Doctors

✅Bonus Coupon for Doctor Chat after Procedure


Benefits of the Influenza Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra)

  • Protection Against Influenza. Helps prevent infection from circulating strains of Influenza A and B.
  • Reduced Risk of Complications. Minimizes the chance of developing serious complications like pneumonia, bronchitis, and exacerbation of chronic diseases.
  • Boosts Immune Readiness. Enhances your immune system’s ability to respond effectively to seasonal influenza viruses.


Vaccine Composition (Vaxigrip Tetra)

This vaccine contains inactivated influenza viruses, covering two type A strains (H1N1 and H3N2) and two type B strains.


Who Should Receive the Influenza Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra)?

  • Children aged 6 months and older
  • Adults and the elderly
  • Individuals with chronic illnesses such as asthma, diabetes, and heart disease
  • Pregnant women, to protect themselves and their unborn babies
  • Healthcare workers and individuals who frequently interact with many people


Influenza Vaccine (Vaxigrip Tetra) Schedule

The flu vaccine is administered annually because influenza viruses constantly mutate. Ideally, it should be given before the flu season begins to ensure maximum protection.


Contraindications

  • Severe allergy to any component of the vaccine, including egg protein
  • History of severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of the influenza vaccine
  • Individuals experiencing a high fever or acute infection (vaccination should be postponed)
